name: Expanded Strategies [Psionic]
body:
You develop new strategies at a faster rate than most tacticians.

Prerequisite: Strategy class feature.

Benefit: You gain an additional strategy. You must meet all the prerequisites of that strategy.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you gain a new strategy.
